reviews.title: BE CAREFUL BEFORE SUBSCRIBING!
reviews.text:
This app feels like a trap designed to take your money.

I subscribed for just 3 days, tried the app for around 5 minutes, realised I didn’t like it, and never used it again. Unfortunately, I forgot to cancel before the 3-day period ended.

When I realised and tried to cancel, on Fourthday I was shocked to discover that they were attempting to charge me £22 for a full month. Even worse, when I tried to unsubscribe, I received a message saying that I hadn’t fulfilled my commitments for the next 12 months!

How can an app expect customers to commit to 12 months OR EVEN FOR 1 MONTH  when they thought they were simply signing up for a short subscription? This is extremely misleading and feels completely unfair.

What makes it even more concerning is the suggestion that failure to meet these payments affected my ability to use the Apple Store.

I have never experienced anything like this with other subscription apps. Normally, if you don’t want to continue paying, your subscription you lose access to the service.

Charging someone £22 for a month they don’t even want, after using the app for just 5 minutes, is unacceptable.

PLEASE READ THE TERMS VERY CAREFULLY BEFORE SUBSCRIBING. Don’t make the same mistake I did.

I even have the screenshot of me cancelling the subscription with the date on it. I told apple it was a 7 day trial and if I owed any money I would’ve been charged before may 1st. They wouldn’t listen, kept lying saying I downloaded it on April 4th when I didn’t even have a phone April 4th because I got it replaced and 2 weeks before that it was sitting on my counter broken until I got the money to replace my phone. They continued to say my Apple ID was used for a different date and it wasn’t. They’re trying to make me pay for the app and put in for a refund that I won’t get back because they’ll come up with another excuse on that. Beware downloading these apps because you’ll likely get scammed out of paying for an app you don’t even want or use.

reviews.title: Very poor accuracy
reviews.text: I am using this app to assist identifying Roman coins. The coins I have are hard to read due to wear and age. I took photos of the most legible coins in my collection, but none of the results the app gave me matched my coin. And when it showed my the reference photo the app used to identify my coin, it became obvious to me that it was just a shot in the dark guess that the app made. This app contains no context and uses no tools that are required for identifying ancient coins. I hope this helps people decide whether or not they want to pay money to subscribe to an AI guessing app.

reviews.title: Beware of Fraud
reviews.text:
I was interested in purchasing this app for buying and selling coins. My experience in just a few weeks was not so good. There were lots of listings for coins I was interested in and I must’ve contacted over 100 of them with only three or four responses at most. I purchased three coins and two of the three were fraud. They took my money both Venmo and PayPal with no response on one purchase and the other one sent me mail with no CoinIn in it. When I responded to the buyer he said I’ll look into it and never heard from him. I contact customer service and they don’t respond back. Then they finally do and say they’ll look into it but the problem is there’s no customer protection on this platform. There’s no seller ratings and they do nothing about these people that scam people like myself. On eBay you have a seller rating and protection as a buyer on this page they offer none at your own risk. I’m still trying to get to the bottom with them what they can do to solve this and I hear no response from them. I send multiple emails with details and pictures and I get no answers? The ad advertisement makes it look very easy to sell and buy which is not true.
UPDATE:
After I wrote this I was contacted back by customer service. They were very nice and understanding. They have looked into my fraud and helped me with my requests. Hopefully things will be fixed in the future with marketplace but feel much better with customer service. Thank you.
